summary: Configured inventory-worker on node1 as an enabled systemd service running under the dedicated inventorysvc account. Verified successful recovery after a full node restart without changing the installed RHEL release or kernel.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account and group with a non-login shell.
Verified the worker process runs as inventorysvc.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the service, account identity, executable, OS release, and kernel after restart.

evidence.summary: The validated unit is enabled and active, with the worker as its main process before and after restart.
inventorysvc is a non-login system account; process UID and account UID match before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged. The existing POSIX worker and native systemd were used; no packages or kernel updates were installed.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline boot ID b17495e3-5cde-49a9-b0d1-ab2e1461726a, acknowledged the scheduled native reboot, observed management-path interruption, and recovered with boot ID 7ed3fac1-45b1-4b26-bd34-919c3f61fafe. Post-restart system state was running and inventory-worker was enabled, active, successful, and running as inventorysvc with the executable checksum preserved.
